scientific_integrity: Explicit exact 2-by-2 algebra and all-angle calculus; 2,485 exact-rational supplementary cases and 9,999 grid points are not substituted for the proof. Historical priority beyond specifically compared works is not exhaustively established.
scientific_limitations: Two distinct nonorthogonal real lines in R^2, starting vector on the first line, one Euclidean-residual GMRES step for A=I-P2P1 versus one alternating-projection sweep. The maximum adverse Euclidean error is about 3.74 percent, and full GMRES solves in two steps. Does not cover general subspaces, initializations, or acceleration algorithms; independent validation remains unperformed.
title: Sharp first-step residual–error reversal for GMRES on two-line alternating projections
